metadata.title: The planarity estimate in dimensions five and six
metadata.abstract: Naff's planarity estimate is a crucial tool for analysing singularities of quadratically pinched mean curvature flows in high codimension, showing that high-curvature regions become asymptotically codimension one. Naff established the estimate throughout the full Andrews--Baker pinching range in dimensions at least $7$, while in dimensions $5$ and $6$ a stronger pinching assumption was required. We close this remaining gap, proving the planarity estimate in dimensions $5$ and $6$ throughout the full Andrews--Baker range. The key new ingredient is a sharp Kato-type inequality relating the twisting of the principal normal to the gradient of the second fundamental form.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 五六维平均曲率流的 planarity 估计
analysis.workSummary: 在五、六维完整 Andrews–Baker 二次夹逼范围内建立高余维平均曲率流的 planarity 估计，用尖锐 Kato 型不等式控制主法向扭转与第二基本形式梯度。
analysis.breakthrough: 补齐高曲率区渐近余维一估计在五六维的范围缺口。
analysis.limitations: 渐近余维一是高曲率区域的估计，不能直接断言整个初始子流形已落在某个超平面。
analysis.priorityReason: 补齐高曲率区渐近余维一估计在五六维的范围缺口。
